$comment: Shrink-only floors for JOV-6773 (DS drift: destructive/red -> error token, apps/web). destructiveUtilityCount: {text,bg,border,ring}-destructive is a value-preserving alias of -error (tailwind.config.js maps both to --color-error) -- lower this whenever a follow-up codemods more apps/web call sites. One occurrence (app/globals.css .text-destructive) is expected to remain indefinitely: packages/ui keeps the shadcn destructive variant/prop, and this rule backstops its color resolution. 172->127 in JOV-6773 after converging the apps/web call sites clear of both the component-ship-gate and pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle debt: non-component app/lib files, plus the two apps/web/components pairs whose adjacent test already asserted on the class (SettingsPaymentsSection, BillingActionsSection). One otherwise-safe file (app/app/(shell)/admin/agent-runs/[id]/page.tsx) was left unconverted because it carries an unrelated pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle violation (Card padding) that lint-staged's whole-file --max-warnings=0 run would force this PR to fix; that file's rename is deferred to whoever clears its restyle debt. The remaining components-dir occurrences are blocked from this pass because touching apps/web/components/**/*.tsx under the ship gate requires a touched test that actually renders the component (or a coverage-via receipt) plus an adjacent story in the same diff -- ~26 of those files have no story yet and ~14 have no test that renders them, so converting them means adding that missing coverage first, tracked as a follow-up. rawRedUtilityCount: {text,bg,border,ring}-red-NNN is NOT the same value as --color-error (Tailwind red-500 #ef4444 vs --color-accent-red #f72a36), and not every red-* call site is a danger/error state (e.g. the YouTube brand swatch) -- this floor only blocks new raw-red debt from growing until each call site gets a taste/design review to either become -error or a named brand token.
